hints.title: Aggregate by User Identifier
hints.text: Group the user token records by user identifier and sum the total token consumption.

hints.title: Filter Total Consumption
hints.text: Use a group filter clause to retain only users whose cumulative usage exceeds 10000.

hints.title: Result Ordering
hints.text: Order the resulting records by user identifier in ascending order.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    user_id,
    SUM(token_usage) AS total_usage
FROM UserTokens
GROUP BY user_id
HAVING SUM(token_usage) > 10000
ORDER BY user_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Group aggregation and sort by user_id.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Row-by-row filtering cannot verify cumulative multi-row aggregates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash aggregation uses memory proportional to distinct users.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean GROUP BY, SUM, and HAVING clause filtering.
